title: Weakly Compact Operators Whose Adjoints Preserve $C^*$-Structure
authors: T. S. S. R. K. Rao
summary: Let $Ω$ be a compact Hausdorff space and $X$ be a complex Banach space such that $X^{**}$ is isometric to a $C^*$-algebra. Let $\mathcal{W}(X^*, C(Ω))$ denote the space of weakly compact operators. In this article, we show that the collection of operators $T$ in $\mathcal{W}(X^*, C(Ω))$ such that $T^*$ maps linear extreme points of the unit ball of $C(Ω)^*$ to $C^*$-extreme points of $X^{**}$ is a uniformly strongly extreme set. We also investigate this phenomenon when $X^{**}$ is isometric to a space of all operators on a Banach space.
